description: Escape 1 (geometric/icosahedral-holonomy section) of the Young-lattice synthesis keystone: does the icosahedral A5 / Bring cross-ratio GEOMETRY FORCE a canonical section (1-dim line) of the mult-2 Hom-space V = Hom_{S3}((2,1), Res^{A5}_{S3}(H)) ~= C^2, or does selecting a line still require a free parameter (fit)? Tests, RAW: (1) realize the dim-5 ell=2 irrep H of A5 explicitly (pair-perm rep, H-isotypic projector), restrict to the color-sheet S3<A5, project onto the (2,1)-isotypic, pin dim V=2; (2) compute the centralizer C_{A5}(S3) and normalizer N_{A5}(S3) -- the ONLY sources of a FORCED (basis-independent) operator on V; (3) THE TEST: simple spectrum / unique invariant line vs free selection; (4) icosahedral special cross-ratios (golden-ratio rigidity) -- forced selector or free modulus; (5) h^4=-3/4 falsification reference only. NO fit, NO tuning. Environment: exact permutation-group combinatorics (Python stdlib), numpy for the explicit C^2 rep matrices, mpmath @ compute_dps for RAW substrate/cross-ratio values; engine=python+mpmath.

task2_forced_operator_sources.interpretation: An operator on the C^2 multiplicity space V is FORCED (canonical, basis-independent) iff it is the image of a group element that COMMUTES with the S3-action (centralizer) -- a genuine endomorphism of the isotypic block -- or, weakly, an element of N_{A5}(S3) that preserves the S3-isotypic structure (acting semilinearly). Trivial C and trivial N/S3 => the only forced operator is the scalar identity => NO distinguished line => any section is a free choice.

task2_forced_operator_on_V.only_forced_operator: identity (from C_{A5}(S3)={e}; N=S3 acts within copies, identity on the multiplicity index)
task2_forced_operator_on_V.distinguished_eigenline: none -- the whole C^2 is the eigenspace

task3_THE_TEST.reason: C_{A5}(S3) = {e} (trivial centralizer) and N_{A5}(S3) = S3 (self-normalizing, N/S3 trivial). Therefore NO A5 element induces a non-scalar operator on the C^2 multiplicity space V: the only forced operator is the scalar identity, whose spectrum {1,1} is DEGENERATE -- every line of C^2 is invariant, so NO line is distinguished. Geometry SEPARATES (it produced V = C^2 with the OV/JM content basis of #1687) but does NOT SELECT a canonical line. Selecting a line requires an external, freely-chosen vector => FIT. Exactly parallel to the spinor test #1687 (separation YES, selection NO).

task4_icosahedral_cross_ratio_selector.why: Even granting the icosahedral cross-ratio is a RIGID modulus (golden-ratio special values, A5-orbit of the 12 vertices on CP^1), there is NO derived map from a single cross-ratio value to a LINE in V: the color-tube cross-ratio is KNOT-INDEPENDENT (complex-fibre audit #1669: Sum D(z_c) = 0, conjugate-pair cancellation) and the same for proton and neutron (flavor-cusp audit #1670). There are SEVERAL icosahedral special cross-ratios (phi, 1/phi, 1-phi, harmonic -1, equianharmonic e^{i pi/3}); choosing WHICH one selects the line is itself a free choice. A holonomy/monodromy operator from the Bring covering would have to act on V, but any operator on V factors through End_{S3}(Res H)|_{(2,1)-iso} = M_2(C), whose only A5-FORCED element is the scalar (Task 2/3). So the cross-ratio is a FREE modulus w.r.t. the section, not a forced selector. 'The cross-ratio that gives h^4' would be THE fit.

task5_h4_falsification.reason: Task 3 forces NO canonical line (centralizer & normalizer/S3 both trivial), so there is no derived section to test against h^4 = -3/4. Assigning a line / cross-ratio value to reproduce -3/4 would be exactly the fit the discipline review catches. h^4 = -3/4 remains the RAW invariant of the (2,1) block (borromean_h3_2_1_irrep_derivation); the multiplicity space carries it as a BLOCK invariant, not per-copy (spinor audit #1687), so even a chosen copy would not change it.

VERDICT.one_line: CASE (ii): the icosahedral A5 geometry gives STRUCTURE (it realizes the mult-2 Hom-space V = C^2 with the OV/JM content eigenbasis) but does NOT FORCE a canonical section. The centralizer C_{A5}(S3) = {e} and the normalizer N_{A5}(S3) = S3 (self-normalizing) are BOTH trivial-modulo-S3, so the only A5-forced operator on V is the scalar identity (degenerate spectrum {1,1}, no distinguished line). Geometry SEPARATES but does not SELECT -- exactly the spinor failure mode (#1687). Selecting a line (a cross-ratio value, a holonomy phase) is a FREE parameter => fit. KEYSTONE STANDS: Escape 1 fails the same way Escape 2 did (relocation, not closure).
VERDICT.why_not_i: (i) would require a forced non-scalar operator with simple spectrum / unique invariant line. The centralizer and normalizer/S3 are both trivial, so no such forced operator exists -- the only one is scalar.
VERDICT.why_not_iii: (iii) would require NO geometric structure on V at all. But the geometry DOES act: A5 realizes V = C^2 and S3 acts (block-diagonally) on it. The structure exists; it just fails to SELECT a line.
VERDICT.delimitation: With Escape 2 falsified (#1694) and Escape 1 now failing, the missing object -- the vertical baryon-number charge / canonical SECTION of the (2,1)-mult space -- is NOT derivable from existing CATEGORICAL (Hecke branching, OV/JM eigenbasis, ribbon-twist spin) OR GEOMETRIC (icosahedral A5 holonomy, Bring cross-ratio) structure. It is a genuine NEW physical input: a forced nominator that neither the representation theory nor the icosahedral rigidity supplies.

caveats: All A5/S3 group-theoretic facts (centralizer trivial, normalizer = S3, Res^{A5}_{S3}(H) = triv (+) 2.(2,1), dim V = 2) are EXACT permutation-group results, q-INDEPENDENT. The icosahedral cross-ratios are RAW golden-ratio special values @ compute_dps. h^4 = -3/4 is the Borromean (2,1)-block invariant used ONLY as a falsification reference; no operator, line, cross-ratio, or normalization is chosen to reproduce it. The Bring color-tube cross-ratio path (closed_form_tau_M, touched by sibling branch claude/vol-density-bz3-refinement) is referenced for context only; this probe changes no production value and emits no LP/SDP solve (no dual required).
